content.short: AssetMantle is a comprehensive toolkit for cross-chain Cosmos-based NFTs.
content.description: AssetMantle is a comprehensive NFT platform serving the Cosmos ecosystem, acting as a one-stop hub for discovering, trading, and managing NFT assets. Since its mainnet launch on April 18, 2020, it began on MantleChain and, through ongoing development, aims to enable full cross-chain NFT functionality across all Cosmos-based blockchains using the IBC protocol. The platform currently offers its own NFT marketplace, a combined crypto and NFT wallet, and a blockchain explorer, all designed and optimized specifically for NFT activity and developer use cases.
